subject: freeSyncMutex

subject: freeSyncWgEdge
why: the Done-to-Wait edge orders the bare-looking write/read pair on every schedule

subject: freeSyncOnceEdge
why: the Once completion edge orders the single write before both Do returns on every schedule

subject: freeSyncRwWriters
why: write-unlock to write-lock (semA) orders the two increments whichever order the schedule realizes — the green twin of negative-sync/rlock-serialized
